name: aggregate-empty-null
$comment: Scalar aggregate over an EMPTY match set is bare null: compile_aggregate_scalar emits SELECT COALESCE(to_jsonb(SUM(col)), 'null'::jsonb), and SUM over zero rows is SQL NULL (both the COALESCE arm and to_jsonb(SQL NULL) itself land on JSON null). A matching row exists in the table (status 'todo'), so the empty set is a real eq miss, not an empty table. Wire shape: eq ['ghost'] on [status, order] leaves `order` as the aggregate field (sum requires a numeric field).
